name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.verify.FunVerifyListActivity
description: When a user opens verification messages in the older ContactKit UI, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lists friend applications and team invitations or join requests, with accept, reject, and clear-all actions.
disableEffect: Users can no longer review, respond to, or clear ContactKit friend and team verification messages.
